why: Ringworm is a contagious fungal skin infection. On hands or feet, it may form itchy rings, peeling skin, or small blisters.
ringworm（癣）是一种会传染的真菌性皮肤感染。发生在手足时，可能出现瘙痒的环形斑、脱皮或小水疱。
lock: ringworm = fungal infection; scabies = animal parasite.
ringworm = 真菌感染；scabies（疥疮）= 动物寄生虫感染。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Infectious Skin Disorders

why: Liquids form vapors when they evaporate into air. Monomer liquid, gel ingredients, and adhesives release vapors rather than smoke-like fumes.
液体蒸发到空气中会形成 vapor（蒸气）。单体液、凝胶成分和粘合剂释放的是蒸气，不是含烟尘的 fumes（烟雾）。
lock: liquid evaporates = vapor; burning material = fumes.
液体蒸发 = vapor；物质燃烧 = fumes。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Gases, Vapors, and Fumes

why: A fissure is a crack that reaches into living skin. Secondary lesions develop after skin damage or a change in a primary lesion.
fissure（皲裂）是深入活体皮肤的裂口。继发性皮损会在皮肤受损后，或原发性皮损发生变化后形成。
lock: fissure = secondary crack in the skin.
fissure = 皮肤上的继发性裂口。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Secondary Skin Lesions

why: Traditional nail polish hardens as solvents evaporate and leave a coating behind. It does not need the polymerization used by enhancement products.
传统指甲油中的溶剂蒸发后，会留下并形成涂层。它不需要像美甲增强材料那样发生聚合反应。
lock: nail polish = solvent evaporation; enhancements may polymerize.
指甲油 = 溶剂蒸发；美甲增强材料可能发生聚合。
refs: Nail Product Chemistry - Nail Coating Products

why: Cysts and tubercles are raised primary lesions that may occur above or below the skin. Both require medical referral, not salon treatment.
cyst（囊肿）和 tubercle（结节）都是可位于皮肤表面或下方的隆起性原发皮损，都应转介医疗人员，不能在沙龙处理。
lock: raised primary lesion = recognize and refer.
隆起性原发皮损 = 识别后转介。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Primary Skin Lesions

why: Natural nails are skin appendages made mainly of keratin. They grow from matrix cells rather than being made primarily of calcium.
天然指甲是皮肤的附属器官，主要由 keratin（角蛋白）构成。它由甲母质细胞生长形成，并非主要由钙构成。
lock: natural nail = keratin skin appendage.
天然指甲 = 由角蛋白构成的皮肤附属器官。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Natural Nail Structure

why: Onychocryptosis occurs when a nail grows into the tissue at its side. The painful area requires medical referral when infection, redness, or swelling appears.
onychocryptosis（嵌甲症）是指指甲长入侧边组织。若出现感染、发红或肿胀，疼痛部位应转介医疗人员。
lock: onychocryptosis = nail growing into side tissue.
onychocryptosis = 指甲长入侧边组织。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Overview of Nail Diseases

why: Nail psoriasis can affect the nail bed and create yellow-red salmon patches beneath the plate. It may also cause pitting or roughness.
nail psoriasis（甲银屑病）会影响甲床，在甲板下形成黄红色的鲑鱼斑，也可能造成点状凹陷或粗糙。
lock: salmon patches under the plate = nail psoriasis.
甲板下的鲑鱼斑 = nail psoriasis。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Nail Psoriasis

why: A reusable metal implement must be cleaned before proper disinfection. Disinfection kills most harmful germs remaining on the hard surface.
可重复使用的金属器械必须先清洁，再正确消毒。disinfection（消毒）会杀死坚硬表面残留的大多数有害微生物。
lock: reusable metal implement: clean first, disinfect second.
可重复使用的金属器械：先清洁，再消毒。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Cleaning and Disinfecting

why: The extensor digitorum longus bends the foot upward and extends the toes. Other lower-leg muscles move the foot in different directions.
extensor digitorum longus（趾长伸肌）使足部向上弯曲并伸展脚趾。其他小腿肌肉负责不同方向的足部动作。
lock: extensor digitorum longus = foot up, toes extend.
extensor digitorum longus = 足部上抬，脚趾伸展。
refs: General Anatomy and Physiology - Muscles of the Lower Leg and Foot

why: Rinsing removes disinfectant residue after the required contact time. Drying prevents dilution and contamination before the implement is stored in a clean place.
达到规定接触时间后，冲洗可去除消毒剂残留；擦干可避免稀释和污染，再把器械存放在清洁处。
lock: after disinfectant: rinse, dry, then store clean.
取出消毒剂后：冲洗、擦干，再清洁存放。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Disinfecting Reusable Items

why: Bacteria are microscopic living organisms commonly called microbes or germs. Some are harmless or helpful, while pathogenic bacteria can cause disease.
bacteria（细菌）是微小的活体生物，也常称为 microbes 或 germs。有些无害或有益，致病菌则会引起疾病。
lock: bacteria = microbes; pathogenic bacteria cause disease.
bacteria = 微生物；致病性细菌会引起疾病。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Bacteria

why: Phalanges are the bones of the fingers and toes. Each finger has three phalanges, while each thumb has two.
phalanges（指骨和趾骨）构成手指和脚趾。每根手指有三节指骨，每个拇指有两节。
lock: phalanges = finger and toe bones.
phalanges = 手指和脚趾的骨骼。
refs: General Anatomy and Physiology - Bones of the Hand and Foot

why: Skin covers and protects the entire body. Its large surface area makes it the body's largest organ.
皮肤覆盖并保护全身。由于覆盖面积很大，它是人体最大的器官。
lock: skin = protective covering and largest organ.
皮肤 = 保护性覆盖层，也是最大的器官。
refs: Skin Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Functions of the Skin

why: Onychomycosis is a fungal infection of the nail plate. It may cause white patches, pale yellow streaks, or a crumbling free edge.
onychomycosis（甲真菌病）是甲板的真菌感染，可能出现白斑、淡黄色条纹或游离缘碎裂。
lock: onychomycosis = fungal nail infection.
onychomycosis = 指甲真菌感染。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Overview of Nail Diseases

why: A warm oil manicure softens and conditions dry skin around an agnail. Cutting living surrounding skin can cause injury and infection.
温油手部护理可软化并滋润倒刺周围的干燥皮肤。剪切周围的活体皮肤可能造成受伤和感染。
lock: agnail care = soften and condition; do not cut living skin.
倒刺护理 = 软化并滋润；不要剪活体皮肤。
refs: Manicuring - Conditioning Oil Manicure

why: Cuticle is dead tissue attached to the nail plate. The living eponychium surrounds the plate and should not be cut.
cuticle（甲小皮）是附着在甲板上的死亡组织；eponychium（甲上皮）是甲板周围的活体组织，不应剪切。
lock: cuticle = dead tissue on plate; eponychium = living skin.
cuticle = 甲板上的死亡组织；eponychium = 活体皮肤。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Nail Anatomy

why: Cuticle removers contain strong alkaline ingredients that dissolve dead tissue. Leaving them too long can irritate or burn living skin.
甲小皮软化剂含有能溶解死亡组织的强碱性成分。停留过久会刺激或灼伤活体皮肤。
lock: cuticle remover = alkaline; limit contact time.
甲小皮软化剂 = 碱性；限制接触时间。
refs: Manicuring - Nail Cosmetics - Cuticle Removers

why: A pumice stone is porous, so it cannot be properly disinfected. A porous implement must be discarded after one service.
浮石具有多孔性，无法被正确消毒。多孔器械每次服务后都必须丢弃。
lock: porous implement = single use, then discard.
多孔器械 = 一次性使用，之后丢弃。
refs: Milady Standard Foundations - Infection Control - Single-Use Items

why: The matrix produces nail plate cells. Its size, length, and shape influence the plate's thickness, width, and curvature.
matrix（甲母质）产生甲板细胞。甲母质的大小、长度和形状会影响甲板的厚度、宽度和弧度。
lock: matrix shape controls nail plate shape.
甲母质形状决定甲板形状。
refs: Nail Structure, Disorders, and Diseases - Matrix
